summary: 18 observed issues fixed in the local patch. Five native personas reran real AI edits after the fixes; production account onboarding remains unverified.
pricing_policy: Free during alpha; agent usage is paid directly to the provider using the user’s own ACP account and plan. Gui adds no AI usage charges.

issues.title: Unannounced automatic example and hidden demo limits
issues.change: The demo discloses its supported changes before entry, labels the example, offers Try it yourself, and explains its busy state.

issues.title: The first button assumes an existing project; welcome choices need explanation
issues.change: New project is the primary action on a fresh welcome. Returning users keep Open project. Helper copy explains New project, New canvas and Open project, with clearer tooltips.

issues.title: Ordinary “Make this bold.” request rejected
issues.change: Typed bold/bolder, serif, and blue requests now run the supported changes on selected text.

issues.title: Gui price and policy context missing at decision points
issues.change: Owner confirmed free during alpha. Website, Terms, native sign-in, Account settings and agent setup now explain that agent usage uses the user’s own account and plan, paid directly to the provider, with no Gui AI usage charges. Account settings links Terms and Privacy.

issues.title: Back exposes an internal blank page and Reload cannot recover
issues.change: Navigation stops at the internal about:blank boundary. Back/Forward flags reflect valid destinations; Reload and hard reload recover an already stranded preview using its last app address.

issues.title: Marketing subscription bundled with new accounts
issues.change: New accounts start with updates off; existing preferences survive. Sign-in, Terms, Privacy, docs and account tests agree. Human review is required before landing the account-service patch.

issues.title: Phone preview shrinks body text to about 9px
issues.change: At 375px the preview is 343px wide, with scale 0.914667 and its own scroll area.

issues.title: Phone suggestion and Undo buttons only 28px high
issues.change: Mobile suggestions, Undo, send and toolbar controls have at least 44px touch targets.

issues.title: Back leaves an open dialog flow
issues.change: Waitlist and demo use same-document history entries; Back closes and Forward restores. A regression also covers delayed dialog close events.

issues.title: Double-clicking the waitlist opener dismisses it
issues.change: Repeated backdrop clicks are ignored; the modal survives a double click. Duplicate submissions are guarded and pending work is cancelled when the dialog closes.

issues.title: Landing description assumes “agent harness” knowledge
issues.change: The hero explains select, describe, edit; Cost and setup names the Gui account and agent requirement.

issues.title: An automatically tucked chat hides the finished result
issues.change: Turn completion restores a chat that tucked automatically. Manual hiding, minimizing and focus mode retain their user-selected state.

issues.title: Picked elements are named with HTML tags and a raw CSS path
issues.change: A picked heading is named Heading; other common elements have plain names. Technical selectors remain in tooltips and agent context.

issues.title: The first-edit safety notice assumes Git vocabulary
issues.change: The notice explains that a Git branch is a separate version of the project and that the original stays unchanged. The direct-edit action has an explanatory tooltip.

issues.title: Auto starts enabled without a visible explanation of its scope
issues.change: Before the first message, the composer explains that Auto permits edits and commands, including commands outside the project, and how to turn it off to review more requests. Existing detailed help and permission behavior remain intact.

issues.title: Download gives no next installation steps
issues.change: The download action reveals instructions for opening the DMG, installing Gui, signing in, choosing an agent and starting New canvas.

issues.title: Saving feedback uses the same red as errors
issues.change: Pending feedback now uses neutral text; error feedback retains red.

issues.title: Picking instructions disappear while the user is still reading
issues.change: Picking instructions remain visible until the first pointer action instead of disappearing after four seconds.

limits: These are local source fixes. Nothing was committed, deployed or released. Account-service changes require human review before landing under AGENTS.md.

Five native personas used isolated ordinary development profiles (GUI_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED=0) and the real Claude Code provider account already available on this Mac. Their edits changed real scratch-project files. No ACP stand-ins were used for persona proof.

Production account-required sign-in, fresh provider authentication, native installation from the downloaded DMG, and every external provider remain unproven. Gui sign-in accepts legal terms and awaits the user’s explicit approval; it was not clicked by QA.

The actual website was exercised in real browser tabs. The native editor is a Mac application, whose minimum window is not a 375px phone. Mobile website coverage used 375px and a 400kbit/s + 400ms server throttle. Native mobile preview used the built-in 390px preset and a slow scratch server; exact 375px native tool use was agent-reported, not independently verified.
Counts are distinct personas who reported a problem, not independent human participants or a statistical sample. All one-person ties are ordered by severity.

Harness-only issues (temporary app path capture, renamed Electron executable behavior, keyboard focus routing, localhost IPv6 collision and timing contention) are excluded from product defect counts. The proposed automated chat-focus test was removed because it did not faithfully reproduce native interaction; its unsuccessful attempts are not presented as passing coverage.

triage.transient_ax_placeholder: Immediate native AX can retain Queue while pixels show Ask. Skeptic Undo/Redo and independent same-process capture report Ask; accessible input name stays correct. Retained as a transient capture observation, excluded from confirmed defects.
triage.fixture_redo: Resolved by directory watching in the scratch server. Product file restore and HTTP output were already correct. Actual double Undo/Redo visibly passed after fixture restart.
